args.goal: Test whether an ecommerce agency with a current, buyer-authored request for catalogue migration, reconciliation or release QA could buy one small, standalone review using the existing checker and operator order handoff. Read the saved catalogue buyer-request-path, referral and qualified-inquiry evidence first. Reuse equivalent work and exclude the existing item 4 pilot, previously examined listings and public procurement portals. Inspect at most two current original requests on public agency or buyer-controlled pages. Require explicit paid intent, a published response route that permits the proposed use, and a concrete deliverable feasible with fictional data and the available offline tools. For the first fit, run one fictional before/after example against a quoted buyer criterion, save the source URL and hash, exact command and output, and prepare a copy-ready bilingual operator response citing the current verified offer and disclosing AI assistance. Keep price and acceptance pending actual buyer and operator evidence. If no request qualifies, record the specific exclusion and close without expanding the search. Save and read back the result under a valid lease and close with a lesson. No external contact, submission, registration, spending or deployment.
